		<headline>Pingyang County Meteorological Observatory issues a yellow typhoon warning [Level III/Severe]</headline>
		<description>The Pingyang County Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow typhoon warning signal at 12:11 on October 23, 2026: Due to the impact of Typhoon Qiangpi, the 30th typhoon of this year, it is expected that the coastal sea surface wind force in our county will be 11-13 levels tonight and the day after tomorrow, and the land wind force will be 8-10 levels tonight and the day after tomorrow; It will be cloudy and heavy to rainstorm from tonight to tomorrow, and cloudy and showery the day after tomorrow. Please all relevant parties pay attention to prevention.</description>
		<instruction>1. The government and relevant departments should make emergency preparations for typhoon prevention; 2. Take proactive measures for water operations in relevant waters and for passing ships, with a focus on reinforcing port facilities to prevent ships from anchoring, stranding, and colliding; 3. Residents in dangerous areas should take shelter from the wind in the shelter. Outdoor operators at high altitude, mudflat, water and other places should stop working. Workers in dangerous areas should be evacuated in time. Open collective activities should be stopped in time and personnel evacuation should be done well; 4. Close doors and windows tightly, reinforce or dismantle structures that are easily moved by the wind, personnel should not go out at will, elderly and children should stay in safe places such as homes, and personnel in dangerous buildings should be transferred in a timely manner; 5. Check the drainage system of cities and farmland, and take necessary drainage measures.</instruction>
		<area>
			<areaDesc>Pingyang County</areaDesc>
			<geocode>
				<valueName>CPEAS Geographic Code</valueName>
				<value>330326000000</value>
			</geocode>
		</area>

		<senderName>李传祥</senderName>
		<headline>平阳县气象台发布台风黄色预警[Ⅲ级/较重]</headline>
		<description>平阳县气象台2026年10月23日12时11分发布台风黄色预警信号：受今年第30号台风“蔷琵”影响，预计今天夜里到后天我县沿海海面风力11-13级，陆域风力今天夜里到后天8-10级；今天夜里到明天阴有大到暴雨，后天阴有阵雨。请各有关方面注意防范。</description>
		<instruction>1.政府及相关部门做好防台应急准备工作； 2.相关水域水上作业和过往船舶采取积极的应对措施，重点加固港口设施，防止船舶走锚、搁浅和碰撞； 3.处在危险地带的居民应到避风场所避风，高空、滩涂、水上等户外作业人员应停止作业，危险地带工作人员应及时撤离，露天集体活动应及时停止，并做好人员疏散工作； 4.关紧门窗，加固或者拆除易被风吹动的搭建物，人员不随意外出，老人、儿童留在家中等安全地方，危房内人员及时转移； 5.检查城市、农田排水系统，采取必要的排涝措施。</instruction>
		<area>
			<areaDesc>平阳县</areaDesc>
			<geocode>
